name: Armors
description: Concrete armor forms with independent rarity and materials

fields.description: Layers of quilted cloth soften impacts while preserving freedom of movement.
A fitted, heavily quilted coat worn alone or beneath harder protection.
A flexible suit of shaped panels suited to travel and mobile combat.
Flexible armor strengthened at vulnerable points without becoming cumbersome.
A close-fitted protective coat cut for quick footwork and precise movement.
A short linked shirt that protects the torso without the weight of a full hauberk.
Overlapping scales cover a flexible backing and turn aside glancing blows.
Small overlapping plates are riveted inside a sturdy fitted garment.
Rows of small rigid plates are laced together into resilient protection.
A shaped rigid cuirass protects the torso while leaving the limbs relatively free.
Broad hidden plates line a heavy coat for balanced coverage and mobility.
A long, dense suit of interlocking links provides extensive protection.
Long rigid strips reinforce a heavy backing across the body and limbs.
Articulated plates protect most of the body with carefully fitted joints.
A complete articulated harness encloses its wearer from head to foot.
Massive reinforced protection is built for the most punishing assaults.
